key_insight: IneqAgent combines LLM-driven reasoning with symbolic computation in Lean4 to prove inequalities by coordinating lemma search, reformulation, and exact certificate generation.
engineering_relevance: The framework shows how agentic control plus verified numerical/symbolic backends can improve formal theorem proving efficiency and reliability for mathematically exact engineering workflows.
method: Lemma-level Monte Carlo Tree Search guides lemma construction and goal reformulation.
Selects among sum-of-squares, Bernstein, and successive difference-substitution backends to produce exact certificates.
Integrates backend proofs with LLM-generated steps and Lean feedback to build complete verified proofs.
evidence_signal: On four benchmarks, IneqAgent with DeepSeek-V4-Flash solved 175 of 186 problems (94.09%), outperforming evaluated methods overall and achieving lower-cost success at low inference thresholds.
watch_item: Performance depends on backend quality, Lean feedback integration, and benchmark-specific proof structure, so robustness on broader theorem classes may vary.
paper_title: IneqAgent: Agentic Inequality Proving in Lean with Symbolic Computation
